objectives: 本課程將介紹傳統照明與前瞻光源相關知識，並讓同學們習得光源與系統分析的技巧。This course introduces fundamental knowledge of conventional lighting and advanced light sources, while providing students with the skills for analyzing light sources and lighting systems.
content:
1. 照明目的 (Purposes of lighting)
2. 室內照明與室外照明 (Outdoor lighting & Indoor lighting)
3. 色彩學簡介 (Introduction to chromatics)
4. 光與視覺 (Light and vision)
5. 矽光子-系統架構 (Silicon photonics – System structure)
6. 矽光子-雷射 (Silicon photonics – Laser)
7. 矽光子-光纖陣列 (Silicon photonics – Fiber array)
8. 矽光子-PIC (Silicon photonics – PIC)
9. AR-VR  - 系統架構 (AR-VR – System structure)
10. AR-VR - Micro LED (AR-VR – Micro-LED)
11. 系統或元件光學模擬 LightTools / Rsoft simulation (AR-VR, SiPH)

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限機械工程學系碩士班、機械工程學系光機電工程碩士班、能源工程研究所碩士班。
系所:限機械工程學系。年級:限三年級、四年級。
